acceptance.given: Aggregate evaluation runs with matrix evidence whose fixture, identity, or execution receipt is reused across distinct matrix cases.

oracle.expected: Aggregate status is invalidated with an evidence-invalid or comparison-failed terminal result.
forbidden: Aggregate is treated as valid using reused matrix evidence.
Reuse is accepted because labels or hashes differ without independent execution.
oracle.observable: Aggregate validation receipt identifies the reused evidence and records unsuccessful aggregate status.

acceptance.when: The matrix aggregate validator evaluates case evidence and detects cross-case reuse.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Run aggregate validation with one case's evidence reused for another; repeated runs reject the aggregate deterministically.

affected_subjects: matrix aggregate evidence validation and reused-evidence detection
slice_hint.behavior_change: Reject any aggregate whose matrix cases reuse fixtures, evidence identities, or execution receipts.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Preserve existing aggregate verdict categories and receipt fields; rollback removes only reused-evidence rejection.

slice_hint.terminal_predicate: Aggregate terminal status is unsuccessful and contains attributable reused-evidence details.

acceptance.given: An independent operator starts from a fresh checkout with the frozen Git baseline and all pinned result-determining inputs.

oracle.expected: Verification first reconstructs the original pinned identities, then performs fresh replay with those same identities; terminal semantic verdict and Exact Cover match the original.
forbidden: Fresh replay uses changed, unpinned, or unbound inputs while claiming success.
Terminal semantic verdict or Exact Cover differs from the original.
Identity mismatch is ignored without an approved policy.
oracle.observable: Snapshot, reconstruction, replay, semantic-verdict, and Exact Cover receipts share identical pinned input identities and matching terminal outputs.

acceptance.then: Fresh-checkout reconstruction and replay produce the same terminal semantic verdict, Exact Cover, and bound identities as the original.
acceptance.when: Independent replay verification executes from a fresh checkout using frozen inputs.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Mutate one pinned input or replay with a different identity; reconstruction rejects the run as stale or identity-invalid.

affected_subjects: fresh-checkout semantic replay and Exact Cover reconstruction
slice_hint.behavior_change: Perform two-phase replay: reconstruct original snapshot identities, then execute fresh replay bound to them and compare semantic verdict and bidirectional Exact Cover.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Preserve existing snapshot and semantic-decision formats; rollback removes fresh-replay identity checks only.

slice_hint.terminal_predicate: Replay succeeds only when all pinned identities match and terminal semantic verdict and Exact Cover equal the original; otherwise it is stale or identity-invalid.

acceptance.given: The requested target is outside the supported repository-contained Toolchain Skill package set or is marked unsupported by route policy.

oracle.expected: Target processing is rejected or halted before inspection is accepted, with an unsuccessful invalid-input or identity-invalid result.
forbidden: Processing proceeds with an unsupported target.
Unsupported target is accepted for inspection or yields successful evidence.
oracle.observable: Target-validation receipt records the target, support-policy decision, fail-closed terminal category, and no accepted inspection result.

acceptance.then: The unsupported target is not accepted and processing has failed closed.
acceptance.when: Target validation evaluates a requested unsupported target.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Select an unsupported target fixture and invoke target validation; it terminates unsuccessfully before accepted inspection evidence is emitted.

affected_subjects: supported-target policy and fail-closed target validation
slice_hint.behavior_change: Enforce the supported-target policy before effective inspection and reject unsupported targets without success evidence.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Preserve target-validation receipt fields and fail-closed terminal categories; rollback removes only the unsupported-target gate.

slice_hint.terminal_predicate: No accepted inspection result exists and terminal status is invalid-input or identity-invalid.

acceptance.given: The rebuilt Atomic Obligation register and linked assertions, selectors, commands, witnesses, and runtime evidence are supplied to the Exact Cover validator.

oracle.expected: Validation records 100% bidirectional Exact Cover: every Atomic Obligation maps to required assertion, selector, command, witness, and runtime evidence, and every evidence node maps back to an exact Atomic Obligation with zero orphans.
forbidden: Any Atomic Obligation lacks bidirectional Exact Cover.
Exact Cover is one-way, incomplete, or inferred from aggregate test counts.
Orphan requirement, assertion, selector, command, witness, or runtime-evidence nodes remain.
oracle.observable: Machine-readable coverage receipt reports complete forward and reverse mappings and zero orphan counts.

acceptance.then: 100% of Atomic Obligations have bidirectional Exact Cover and required witnesses.
acceptance.when: SM-1 coverage validation runs against the rebuilt obligation register and evidence graph.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Run Exact Cover validation with one obligation or evidence node disconnected; validator fails with an orphan or reverse-coverage finding.

affected_subjects: Atomic Obligation Exact Cover graph construction and bidirectional validation
slice_hint.behavior_change: Build and validate forward and reverse Exact Cover edges for every Atomic Obligation and evidence node, rejecting missing links and orphans.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Retain coverage receipt shape and obligation identifiers; rollback disables only reverse-edge and orphan checks.

slice_hint.terminal_predicate: Validation passes only with 100% forward and reverse coverage and zero orphan nodes; any gap is unsuccessful.
